about_the_game:
You’ll meet the main character, built with a next-generation locomotion system that delivers fluid and realistic movement. The gameplay focuses on player freedom: switch firing modes on certain weapons to adapt to different situations, and change ammunition types in real time to gain more advanced control in the heat of combat. Choose between automatic and semi-automatic weapons, adapting your combat style to every situation.

Tactical options are always within reach – a flexible cover system allows you to approach every encounter in your own style, while vehicle destruction adds an extra layer of realism and intensity. On top of that, the lockpicking system lets you steal cars discreetly, avoiding the attention of both police and bystanders. But be careful: civilians act as witnesses, reporting your crimes to the police, who will then hunt you down. All of this can be experienced from either third-person or first-person perspective, depending on how you prefer to immerse yourself in the action.

For survival, a sophisticated layering system allows you to use consumables at any moment without interrupting the flow of combat. Advanced physics make every interaction with the environment and AI unpredictable and unique. Meanwhile, the dynamic glass-shattering system, based on impact, adds spectacular visual details and credibility to each action scene.

Another defining feature is the advanced dialogue system, which lets you choose the attitude with which you respond to characters around you – whether friendly or threatening – influencing how they react to you. Every line of dialogue, whether during runtime or cinematic sequences, is fully translated into 35 languages, complete with voice acting and subtitles, so players can experience every emotion at the highest level. The interface itself is also localized, ensuring the most familiar and seamless experience possible worldwide.

The game’s universe is inspired by the urban atmosphere of the late 1950s – a vibrant metropolis full of life and contrast, where crowded cityscapes intertwine with quieter natural areas. Clothing, weapons, vehicles, and the story of the main character have all been crafted with great attention to detail to immerse you in the authenticity of that era.

You’ll also enjoy a story-driven main mission filled with action, complemented by the freedom to explore a section of the map included in this experience.

And when you find yourself overwhelmed by enemies, activate “Adrenaline Mode” – an auto-firing system that allows you to turn the tide in your favor and prove there’s no room for mistakes in battle.

Demo Experience

In the demo, you’ll get a taste of the core systems: an automatic SMG with switchable fire modes, a semi-automatic pistol, and three ammunition types to experiment with. Test out the cover mechanics, destroy a vehicle in real-time combat, and use the lockpicking system to steal cars under the watchful eye of the police, who will actively react to your crimes — often alerted by civilians acting as witnesses.

On top of that, you’ll take part in a story-driven, action-packed mission that sets the tone for what’s to come. Experience both first- and third-person perspectives, a layering system for consumables, advanced “active ragdoll” physics, glass-shattering based on impact, a dialogue system that shapes interactions, and the auto-firing Adrenaline Mode.

Early Access

The complete experience will take everything further. Expect a much larger selection of vehicles – from nimble coupes and practical sedans to heavy trucks and luxurious convertible limousines – offering true diversity and freedom of choice for every player. Alongside this, you’ll have access to a diverse arsenal ranging from shotguns and bolt-action rifles to semi-automatic and automatic weapons, as well as single- and double-action pistols. Expanded ammunition types will give you more tactical depth, including special variants like “No Gravity”, “Catch Fire”, and “Electro”, designed to make combat not only more strategic but also more thrilling and fun.

Explore numerous story-driven main missions filled with intrigue, complemented by captivating side missions. Customization plays a central role: visit stores to tailor your clothing, hairstyle, vehicles, and weapons to your style. Traverse a vast, diverse map that goes beyond the city to forests, mountains, islands, and more, enhanced by an advanced ocean simulation, swimming and boating systems, and dynamic hand-to-hand combat. A day-night cycle with a versatile weather system will ensure that no two moments in the world ever feel the same.

Interiors push immersion to the next level: wander through decaying houses left to time, refined urban residences, creative cultural spaces, and practical environments like shops or factories. Beyond that, you’ll discover a vast shopping mall filled with restaurants and activities, as well as a dazzling casino at the city’s core, where the mix of neon lights and high-stakes tension offers a sharp contrast to the harsh realities of the streets outside.

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Intense Violence or Gore, Suggestive Themes, Strong Language, General Mature Content.
